spells.desc: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.

spells.name: Solar Snare
spells.desc: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.

spells.name: Golden Eclipse
spells.desc: Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm. Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.

passive.name: Vow of the First Lands
passive.desc: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Cultivation of Spirit
spells.desc: Yunara gains Attack Speed, bonus damage On-Hit, and her Attacks spread to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin
spells.desc: Yunara fires a spinning prayer bead that deals damage and slows enemies. While in her Transcendent State she instead fires off a laser that deals damage and slows enemies.

spells.name: Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow
spells.desc: Yunara gains Move Speed and becomes Ghosted. While in her Transcendent State she instead dashes in a direction.

spells.name: Transcend One's Self
spells.desc: Yunara enters a Transcendent State that upgrades her basic Abilities.

passive.name: Silver Stake
passive.desc: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.

spells.name: Ritual Nails
spells.desc: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.

spells.name: Soul Ignition
spells.desc: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.

spells.name: Ashen Pursuit
spells.desc: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.

spells.name: Purgatory
spells.desc: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.

passive.name: Pit Grit
passive.desc: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.

spells.name: Knuckle Down
spells.desc: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions.

spells.name: Haymaker
spells.desc: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.

spells.name: Facebreaker
spells.desc: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.

spells.name: The Show Stopper
spells.desc: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.

passive.name: Dream-Laden Bough
passive.desc: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.

spells.name: Blooming Blows
spells.desc: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge.

spells.name: Watch Out! Eep!
spells.desc: Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center.

spells.name: Swirlseed
spells.desc: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on. If it doesn't hit anything, it will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target.

spells.name: Lilting Lullaby
spells.desc: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.

passive.name: A Thousand Cuts
passive.desc: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

spells.name: Snip Snip!
spells.desc: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

spells.name: Hallowed Mist
spells.desc: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

spells.name: Skip 'n Slash
spells.desc: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage On-Hit for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

spells.name: Needlework
spells.desc: Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit. This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

passive.name: Leverage
passive.desc: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.

spells.name: Handshake
spells.desc: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.

spells.name: Bailout
spells.desc: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.

spells.name: Loyalty Program
spells.desc: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, shielding allies and damaging and slowing enemies hit.

spells.name: Hostile Takeover
spells.desc: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.

passive.name: Spirit Abjuration
passive.desc: Aurora's spells and attacks exorcise spirits from the enemies she damages. Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.

spells.name: Twofold Hex
spells.desc: Aurora sends out a missile that curses any enemies it hits. She can then recast the ability to draw active curses back toward herself, damaging foes who are hit along the way.

spells.name: Across the Veil
spells.desc: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed for a short duration of time.

spells.name: The Weirding
spells.desc: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.

spells.name: Between Worlds
spells.desc: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.

passive.name: Joy Unending
passive.desc: Nilah gains increased experience from last-hitting minions along with the ability to enhance and share nearby healing and shielding from her allies.

spells.name: Formless Blade
spells.desc: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration.

spells.name: Jubilant Veil
spells.desc: Nilah envelops herself in mist, increasing her movement speed and allowing her to gracefully dodge all incoming attacks. Any allies she touches during the mist's duration will also gain this effect.

spells.name: Slipstream
spells.desc: Nilah enthusiastically dashes toward her target, dealing damage to any enemies she passes through on the way.

spells.name: Apotheosis
spells.desc: Twirling her whip-blade in joyful exuberance, Nilah deals damage to enemies around her before pulling them closer with her weapon.

passive.name: Dauntless Instinct
passive.desc: K'Sante's Abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next Attack. When All Out, K'Sante deals more damage with all Attacks and Abilities.

spells.name: Ntofo Strikes
spells.desc: K'Sante strikes, damaging and slowing enemies in a short line. On hit, grants a stack of Ntofo Strikes. At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in. When All Out, cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Path Maker
spells.desc: K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies. When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.

spells.name: Footwork
spells.desc: K'Sante dashes and gains a shield. If targeting an ally, K'Sante dashes to the ally with increased range and both gain a shield. When All Out, cooldown is reduced and speed is increased.

spells.name: All Out
spells.desc: K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path. Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.

passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.desc: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

spells.name: Super Scorcher Breath
spells.desc: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.

spells.name: Achooo!
spells.desc: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.

spells.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
spells.desc: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.

spells.name: MMOOOMMMM!
spells.desc: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.

passive.name: Fired Up!
passive.desc: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

spells.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
spells.desc: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.

spells.name: Cozy Campfire
spells.desc: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.

spells.name: Warm Hugs
spells.desc: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.desc: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.

passive.name: Cultivation of War
passive.desc: Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.

spells.name: The Darkin Glaive
spells.desc: Zaahen slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself. Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target.

spells.name: Dreaded Return
spells.desc: Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.

spells.name: Aureate Rush
spells.desc: Zaahen dashes to a location and slices around himself.

spells.name: Grim Deliverance
spells.desc: Zaahen rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

passive.name: Signature of the Visionary
passive.desc: Hwei primes enemy champions he damages with his abilities for his signature finishing touch. Hitting an enemy with a second damaging spell completes his signature, leaving it beneath them. The signature detonates after a short delay, dealing magic damage to all enemies in range.

spells.name: Subject: Disaster
spells.desc: Hwei envisions a series of disasters, allowing him to paint a devastating blow. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with damaging abilities: Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, and Molten Fissure.

spells.name: Subject: Serenity
spells.desc: Hwei envisions a series of serenities, allowing him to paint invigorating settings. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with utility abilities: Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, and Stirring Lights.

spells.name: Subject: Torment
spells.desc: Hwei envisions a series of torments, allowing him to paint controlling visages. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw.

spells.name: Spiraling Despair
spells.desc: Hwei paints a vision of pure despair. The first enemy champion struck becomes the center of an expanding painting that slows and damages nearby enemies. The vision explodes after reaching its maximum size or when the champion dies.

950.name: Naafiri
950.title: the Hound of a Hundred Bites

passive.name: We Are More
passive.desc: Naafiri spawns packmates that attack the targets of her attacks and abilities.

spells.name: Darkin Daggers
spells.desc: Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding. Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.

spells.name: The Call of the Pack
spells.desc: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

spells.name: Eviscerate
spells.desc: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.

spells.name: Hounds' Pursuit
spells.desc: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.

1043.name: Recurve Bow
1043.desc: 15% Attack Speed Sting Attacks deal 15 bonus physical damage On-Hit.

1054.name: Doran's Shield
1054.desc: 110 Health Enduring Focus Restore 4 Health every 5 seconds. After taking damage from a champion, restore Health over 8 seconds. Helping Hand Attacks deal 5 bonus physical damage to minions.

1056.name: Doran's Ring
1056.desc: 18 Ability Power 90 Health Drain Restore 1 Mana every second, increased to 2 Mana per second for 5 seconds after dealing damage to an enemy champion. If you can't gain Mana, heal for 45% of this value instead. Helping Hand Attacks deal 5 bonus physical damage to minions.

1111.name: Jarvan I's
1111.desc: 25% Attack Speed 100 Move Speed 10 Ability Haste 12 Magic Penetration 25 Armor 20 Magic Resist 30% Tenacity Jarvan One Gives you stats and passives from all boots. Requires Augment: Quest: Sneakerhead

1120.name: Doran's Helm
1120.desc: 150 Health 8 Armor 8 Magic Resist Helping Hand Attacks deal 5 bonus physical damage to minions.

1502.name: Reinforced Armor
1502.desc: Reinforced Turrets take 80% reduced damage, including True Damage, when no enemy Lane Minions or Rift Herald are nearby. Melee Weakness Turrets take 20% increased damage from melee Champions.

1505.name: Reinforced Armor
1505.desc: Reinforced Turrets take 80% reduced damage, including True Damage, when no enemy Lane Minions or Rift Herald are nearby. Melee Weakness Turrets take 20% increased damage from melee Champions. Regeneration Inhibitor turrets have health regeneration but cannot regenerate past their current segment at 30%, 75%, and 100% health.

1506.name: Reinforced Armor
1506.desc: Reinforced Turrets take 80% reduced damage, including True Damage, when no enemy Lane Minions or Rift Herald are nearby. Melee Weakness Turrets take 20% increased damage from melee Champions. Regeneration Inhibitor turrets have health regeneration but cannot regenerate past their current segment at 30%, 75%, and 100% health.

2001.name: Recall
2001.desc: Teleports your champion to the Summoning Platform after 8 seconds. Any damage taken will cancel the teleport.

2003.name: Health Potion
2003.plain: Consume to restore Health over time

2031.name: Refillable Potion
2031.plain: Restores Health over time. Refills at shop.
2031.desc: Active (2 charges) Restores 100 Health over 12 seconds. Refills upon visiting the shop.

2051.name: Guardian's Horn
2051.desc: 150 Health Recovery: Restores 20 Health every 5 seconds.Undaunted: Blocks 15 damage from attacks and spells from champions (25% effectiveness vs. damage over time abilities).

2052.name: Poro-Snax
2052.desc: Active - Consume: Serves a scrumptious scoop to a nearby Poro, causing it to grow in size. This savory blend of Avarosan hen and local Freljordian herbs—picked daily and flash-frozen—contains the essential nutrients necessary to keep your Poro cool and calm. All proceeds will be donated towards preserving the habitat of the endangered Spotted Poro.

2065.name: Shurelya's Battlesong
2065.plain: Activate to speed up nearby allies.
2065.desc: 50 Ability Power 15 Ability Haste 4% Move Speed 125% Base Mana Regen Inspiring Speech Grant nearby allies 30% Move Speed for 4 seconds.

2138.name: Elixir of Iron
2138.plain: Temporarily increases defenses. Leaves a trail for allies to follow.
2138.desc: Consume Grants 300 Health, 25% Tenacity and increased size for 3 minutes. While active, you leave a path behind that boosts allied champions' Move Speed by 15%.

2139.name: Elixir of Sorcery
2139.plain: Temporarily grants Ability Power and Bonus Damage to champions and turrets.
2139.desc: Consume Grants 50 Ability Power and 15% Mana Regen for 3 minutes. While active, damaging a champion or turret deals 25 bonus true damage (5s against champions).

2140.name: Elixir of Wrath
2140.plain: Temporarily grants Attack Damage and heals you when dealing physical damage to champions.
2140.desc: Consume Grants 30 Attack Damage and 12% Physical Vamp against champions for 3 minutes.

2141.name: Cappa Juice
2141.desc: Helps you get on a head.Active - Consume: This juice does nothing.

2150.name: Elixir of Skill
2150.desc: Consume Grants 1 Skill Point. This item does not increase your level or allow allocating skill points past the normal maximum in a skill

2151.name: Elixir of Avarice
2151.desc: Consume Grants 5 true damage on hit against minions for 60 seconds. When this effect expires, gain 60 gold.

2152.name: Elixir of Force
2152.desc: Consume Grants 25 Adaptive Force for 60 seconds.

2420.name: Seeker's Armguard
2420.plain: Activate to become invincible but unable to take actions
2420.desc: 40 Ability Power 25 Armor Time Stop (Single use) Enter Stasis for 2.5 seconds.

2422.name: Slightly Magical Footwear
2422.desc: 25 Move Speed Grants an additional 10 Move Speed. Boots that build from Slightly Magical Footwear retain this bonus Move Speed.

2501.name: Overlord's Bloodmail
2501.desc: 30 Attack Damage 550 Health Tyranny Gain 2.5% of your bonus Health as Attack Damage. Retribution Gain up to 12% increased Attack Damage based on your percent missing Health.

2502.name: Unending Despair
2502.desc: 400 Health 50 Armor 15 Ability Haste Anguish Every 4 seconds while in combat with champions, deal magic damage to nearby enemy champions and heal for 250% of the damage dealt.

2503.name: Blackfire Torch
2503.desc: 80 Ability Power 600 Mana 20 Ability Haste Baleful Blaze Damaging Abilities deals bonus magic damage for 3 seconds. Blackfire For each enemy champion, epic and large monster affected by your Baleful Blaze, gain 4% Ability Power.

2504.name: Kaenic Rookern
2504.desc: 400 Health 80 Magic Resist 100% Base Health Regen Magebane After not taking magic damage for 15 seconds, gain a magic shield.

2508.name: Fated Ashes
2508.desc: 30 Ability Power Inflame Damaging Abilities deal 15 bonus magic damage over 3 seconds. Deals an additional 45 magic damage to monsters.

2510.name: Dusk and Dawn
2510.desc: 300 Health 60 Ability Power 20 Ability Haste 20% Attack Speed Spellblade (0s) After using an Ability, your next Attack deals bonus magic damage and heals you for On-Hit and then applies On-Hit effects an additional time.

2512.name: Fiendhunter Bolts
2512.desc: 45% Attack Speed 25% Critical Strike Chance 4% Move Speed Night Vigil Gain 30 Ultimate Ability Haste. Opening Barrage After casting your Ultimate, your next 3 basic attacks gain 50% Attack Speed and Critically Strike for 80% of your normal Critical Strike damage for 8 seconds. If an attack would already Critically Strike, instead it deals 15% bonus true damage.

2517.name: Endless Hunger
2517.desc: 65 Attack Damage 5% Omnivamp 20% Tenacity Famine Gain Ability Haste based on your Bonus AD. Feast When a champion that you damaged recently dies, gain Omnivamp for a moderate duration.

2522.name: Actualizer
2522.desc: 90 Ability Power 300 Mana 10 Ability Haste Mana Made Real (0s) For 8 seconds, your mana is Empowered. While Empowered, your spells cost 100% more Mana, you gain increased Ability damage, Shielding, and Healing, and your basic ability cooldowns progress 30% faster.

2523.name: Hexoptics C44
2523.desc: 55 Attack Damage 25% Critical Strike Chance Magnification Deal up to 10% increased damage with Attacks, based on how far away the enemy is (max damage at 500 range). Arcane Aim When a champion that you damaged within 3 seconds dies, gain 100 additional attack range for 8 seconds.

2524.name: Bandlepipes
2524.desc: 200 Health 15 Ability Haste 20 Armor 20 Magic Resist Fanfare Slowing or Immobilizing an enemy champion grants Fanfare for seconds. Fanfare grants you 20 Move Speed. While you have Fanfare, nearby allies, including yourself, gain Attack Speed.

2525.name: Protoplasm Harness
2525.desc: 600 Health 20 Ability Haste Lifeline (0s) Taking damage that would reduce your Health below 30% causes you to gain maximum Health for 5 seconds, then heal Health over the duration. While regenerating Health, you gain 15% increased Size, 10% Move Speed, and 25% Tenacity.

2526.name: Whispering Circlet
2526.desc: 200 Health 8% Heal and Shield Power 75% Base Mana Regen 300 Mana Harmony Gain % Heal and Shield Power. Manaflow (8s, max 5 charges) Landing Abilities grants 4 max Mana (doubled vs. champions). Transforms into Diadem of Songs at 360 max Mana.

2530.name: Diadem of Songs
2530.desc: 200 Health 8% Heal and Shield Power 1000 Mana 100% Base Mana Regen Harmony Gain % Heal and Shield Power. Consonance While you or any ally you've healed or shielded in the last 3 seconds is in combat with champions, each second, heal the lowest health nearby ally champion.

3002.name: Trailblazer
3002.desc: 250 Health 40 Armor 4% Move Speed Lead the Way While moving, build up to 20 bonus Move Speed. At max speed:Create a trail that grants allied champions Move Speed equal to 15% of yours. If you are Melee, your next Attack Slows the target by 50% for 1 second.

3003.name: Archangel's Staff
3003.plain: Increases Ability Power based on maximum Mana
3003.desc: 70 Ability Power 600 Mana 25 Ability Haste Awe Gain Ability Power equal to 1% bonus Mana. Manaflow (8s, max 5 charges) Landing Abilities grants 5 max Mana (doubled vs. champions). Transforms into Seraph's Embrace at 360 max Mana.

3004.name: Manamune
3004.plain: Increases Attack Damage based on maximum Mana
3004.desc: 35 Attack Damage 500 Mana 15 Ability Haste Awe Gain bonus Attack Damage. Manaflow (8s, max 4 charges) Landing Attacks and Abilities grants 3 max Mana (doubled vs. champions). Transforms into Muramana at 360 max Mana.

3006.name: Berserker's Greaves
3006.plain: Enhances Move Speed and Attack Speed

3008.name: Gluttonous Greaves
3008.plain: Increases Attack Damage based on maximum Mana
3008.desc: 45 Move Speed 4% Omnivamp Slay Gain 0.6% Omnivamp on Champion takedown, stacking up to 10 times.

3009.name: Boots of Swiftness
3009.plain: Enhances Move Speed and reduces the effect of slows
3009.desc: 55 Move Speed Fleetfooted Reduce the effectiveness of Slows by 25%.

3011.name: Chemtech Putrifier
3011.desc: 35 Ability Power 10% Heal and Shield Power 75% Base Mana Regen 15 Ability Haste Puffcap Toxin: Dealing damage applies 40% Grievous Wounds to champions for 3 seconds. Grievous Wounds reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.

3020.name: Sorcerer's Shoes
3020.plain: Enhances Move Speed and magic damage

3031.name: Infinity Edge
3031.desc: 75 Attack Damage 25% Critical Strike Chance 30% Critical Strike Damage

3032.name: Yun Tal Wildarrows
3032.desc: 50 Attack Damage 45% Attack Speed 0% Critical Strike Chance Practice Makes Lethal On-Attack, gain Critical Strike Chance permanently up to 25%. Flurry On-Attacking an enemy champion, gain 30% Attack Speed for 6 seconds (30 second cooldown). Attacks reduce this cooldown by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds for Critical Strikes.

3033.name: Mortal Reminder
3033.plain: Overcomes enemies with high Health recovery and Armor
3033.desc: 35 Attack Damage 30% Armor Penetration 25% Critical Strike Chance Grievous Wounds Dealing physical damage applies 40% Wounds to enemy champions for 3 seconds.

3036.name: Lord Dominik's Regards
